value.name: Asha takes the bank statements upstairs
value.description: Asha turns toward the stairs carrying the bank statements, leaving Daniel behind.
evidence: Asha tucked the bank statements under her arm and turned toward the stairs.

value.name: Daniel yields the stairway
value.description: Daniel steps back against the wainscoting to let Asha pass, still unsure whether to follow or explain himself.
evidence: on the third tread he stepped back against the wainscoting to let her past, the strained almost-smile still fixed on his face as if he hadn't decided yet whether to follow or to stay and explain.

value.name: Rosa watches Daniel at the stairs
value.description: Rosa follows Asha to the foot of the stairs and fixes her attention on Daniel instead of going up.
evidence: Rosa moved after Asha to the foot of the stairs and stopped there, the folded towel left behind on the table, her eyes set on Daniel rather than on the climb, and Daniel did not try the smile on her again.

value.name: Asha climbs the narrow stairwell
value.description: Asha ascends the worn stairwell toward the attic, passing through the lingering smell of old wood.
evidence: The narrow stairwell smelled less of eucalyptus and more of old wood as Asha rose, the runner worn pale down the center where thirty years of laundry baskets had gone up and come down.

value.name: Asha enters the attic
value.description: Asha reaches the top of the stairs and finds an unlatched attic door leading into a low-ceilinged space.
evidence: She found the half-landing, the second flight, and at the top a low door already unlatched; through it the slope of the attic ceiling and, against the far wall, the shelf above a rod of heavy winter coats that still held the shape of the woman who had hung them.

value.name: Asha approaches the shelf above the coats
value.description: Asha ducks under the attic ceiling and goes straight to the shelf above the winter coats, intent on reaching something there.
evidence: Asha ducked under the slope of the ceiling and went straight to the shelf above the winter coats, the bank statements still flat under her arm, the dust on the boards muffling her steps.

value.name: Asha strains to reach the shelf
value.description: Because the shelf is set for Rosa's height, Asha has to rise onto her toes and reach past a hatbox to get to it.
